lede: The most consequential meeting this week is San Miguel County's Planning Commission on September 10th, where commissioners will weigh in on three Land Use Code amendments — covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy — before any changes move to the BOCC. The Telluride Hospital District board also meets September 11th for a closed work session with CommonSpirit Health on a potential partnership that could shape the future of local healthcare. Rounding out the week, the county's Housing Code Update working group holds its eighth session September 15th, drilling into proposed changes meant to remove Land Use Code barriers to affordable and workforce housing.
